title: 第163章 杀人还是伤人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋禾瞬间明白婆母的意思。

沈绣屏一边往家里走，一边对宋禾道：“人多了之后就是这样，以次充好，欺上瞒下，颠倒白黑，甚至是相互攻讦。你要做的，就是在各种纷杂的信息里挑出对的那个。

识人用人，听起来容易，其实很难。人不是一成不变的，对方以前好，不代表以后还会好。以前坏，不代表对方不做对的事。”

宋禾点点头。

沈绣屏看向宋禾，笑着问：“知道这次为什么我会叫大伯来处理了吗？”

宋禾道：“因为对方是顾家户的人，大伯的顾家户的族长，交给大伯处理名正言顺，由大伯压着，不论怎么处理，其他族人都不会反对。”

“没错。”沈绣屏点点头，“面对不同的人，不同的情况，处理方式也要不一样。若这次犯事的不是顾家户族人，你大可把对方扭送官府。”

宋禾点点头，“我知道了。”

沈绣屏摸了摸宋禾的头，“这次也算杀鸡儆猴，这段时间，应该没人敢再这么干了。”

宋禾点点头。

同时她在心里叹一口气，也更加清楚的明白为什么做生意都喜欢家族制了。

因为家族本就是天然的利益同盟，就算有人事后翻脸背刺，想要抽身逃走，但只要一想到其亲友还在这里，心中便会生出几丝顾忌。

只要心存顾忌，自然不敢肆意妄为的行事。若是用外人，对方才不管你是谁，后果如何，捅你一刀跑了，你想找都找不到对方。

但这也不绝对，要是真碰见那种毫不顾忌，哪怕是同族亲友，对方也不会顾忌半点，这种人就比如宋穗，比如郑梁。

最近天开始热了，一晃眼玉米田又长成了青纱帐，宋禾抬头看向头顶的太阳，心想，中午等会回去睡一觉。

“咱们真的要去吗？”宋穗看向郑梁。

事到临头，宋穗有些紧张，她怕，万一她去抱孩子的时候被王梅香或者郑枋抓住怎么办？万一自己跑不掉怎么办？

郑梁无所谓的，笑道：“放心吧，我找人做了新的户籍路引，等你抱了孩子，咱们就去府城。”

宋穗听郑梁的话，想起这段时间自己在县城过得日子，又想起之前自己在村里过得日子，她点点头。

“好。”

宋穗小心翼翼的走进郑家，果然这个时间郑家没人，她一进屋就看见自己儿子被放在大笸篮里。

小孩在看见宋穗之后，开始扁嘴哭。

宋穗连忙上前捂住儿子的嘴，生怕儿子的哭声惊动其他人。

就在宋穗想要抱着儿子转身离开的时候，突然迎面碰见小叔子郑栋。

郑栋看见宋穗就是一愣，随即骂道：“是你？你这个不要脸的贱货，你竟然还敢回来！我家早就不要你了，你给我滚，快滚！”

宋穗一直都不喜欢自己这个小叔子，这小子和婆婆王梅香一个样，但今天她只能先稳住郑栋。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Song He instantly understood what his mother-in-law meant.

As Shen Xiuping walked home, she said to Song He: "It's like this when there are more people. They pass off the best as the best, deceive others, confuse right and wrong, and even criticize each other. What you have to do is to pick out the right one among all kinds of complicated information.

Knowing and employing people sounds easy, but it is actually very difficult.People are not static. Just because the other person was good in the past, does not mean that they will be good in the future.Just because someone was bad in the past doesn't mean the other person didn't do the right thing."

Song He nodded.

Shen Xiuping looked at Song He and asked with a smile: "Do you know why I asked my uncle to handle it this time?"

Song He said: "Because the other party is from the Gu family, and the uncle is the patriarch of the Gu family. It is just and reasonable to leave it to the uncle to handle it. The uncle will control it. No matter how it is handled, other clan members will not object."

"That's right." Shen Xiuping nodded, "Faced with different people and different situations, the handling methods should be different. If the person who committed the crime this time is not a member of the Gu family, you can send him to the government."

Song He nodded, "I understand."

Shen Xiuping touched Song He's head and said, "This time it is considered a warning to the monkeys. During this period, no one should dare to do this again."

Song He nodded.

At the same time, she sighed in her heart, and she understood more clearly why she prefers the family system in doing business.

Because the family is a natural alliance of interests, even if someone turns against him and wants to escape, as long as he thinks that his relatives and friends are still here, he will have some scruples in his heart.

As long as you have scruples, you will naturally not dare to act recklessly.If you use an outsider, the other party will not care who you are or what the consequences will be. They will stab you and run away, and you will not be able to find the other party even if you try to find them.

But this is not absolute. If you really meet someone who has no scruples, even if they are relatives and friends of the same race, the other party will not scruple at all. Such people are like Song Sui and Zheng Liang.

The weather has started to get hotter recently, and in the blink of an eye the cornfields have grown into green gauze tents again. Song He raised his head and looked at the sun above his head, thinking that he would go back and take a nap at noon.

"Are we really going?" Song Sui looked at Zheng Liang.

When things came to a close, Song Sui was a little nervous. She was afraid, what if she was caught by Wang Meixiang or Zheng Fang when she went to pick up the child?What if I can’t escape?

Zheng Liang didn't care and said with a smile: "Don't worry, I'll find someone to make a new household registration guide. When you hold the child, we will go to Fucheng."

After listening to Zheng Liang's words, Song Sui thought of her life in the county during this period, and then remembered her life in the village before, and she nodded.

"Okay."

Song Sui walked into Zheng's house cautiously. Sure enough, there was no one in Zheng's house at this time. As soon as she entered the house, she saw her son being placed in a big basket.

After seeing Song Sui, the child started to cry.

Song Sui hurriedly stepped forward and covered her son's mouth, fearing that her son's cries would alert others.

Just when Song Sui was about to turn around and leave with her son in her arms, she suddenly ran into her brother-in-law Zheng Dong.

Zheng Dong was stunned when he saw Song Sui, and then cursed: "Is it you? You shameless bitch, you dare to come back! My family no longer wants you, get out of here, get out of here!"

Song Sui has always disliked her brother-in-law, who is just like her mother-in-law Wang Meixiang, but today she can only stabilize Zheng Dong first.
